policy: handcrafted heuristic using legal options and printed card metadata; official sample deck

local_evaluation.note: Rates use completed valid battles. Do not claim improvement if any game failed. The interval is an approximate binomial interval; it does not account for opponent/deck dependence or native RNG control.

notes: Manual upload occurred after the Colab run. Original Colab status files retain their pre-upload not_submitted flags. Ratings are snapshots. The image does not show the submission ID, absolute observation time, uncertainty or actual Kaggle team name. Local archive hash verified; uploaded archive hash cannot be verified from the image. Local evaluation is against one random opponent with the sample deck, not the hosted match harness. No learned model was trained.
